issue.body:
Can timeout and scheduling changes recover complete positive control pairs without repairing tasks? Follow-up to #28. Investigation remains open.

**Validated existing exports:** four Matchms tasks and four OHIF tasks now have positive nop/oracle control pairs with clean oracle commands. For OHIF, all eight controls completed at the original 300-second verifier limit; all 40 task files are unchanged and both sides preserve their tracked regression tests. These are controls of existing exports, not eight new tasks. [Matchms results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/188091eb/experiments/29-runtime-limits/matchms-control-results.json) · [OHIF results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/a090c9ce/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-control-results.json).

**Other comparisons:** OpenMS's original 60-second checkout timed out again, while a 300-second arm completed the same commit in 77.9 seconds; this establishes acquisition recovery only. Scanpy's 16 recorded bootstrap actions replayed without command repairs, but smoke/fresh checks failed. Its unchanged PR4389 controls at 300 versus 1,200 verifier seconds are still running. [OpenMS evidence](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/875eab80/experiments/29-runtime-limits/openms-checkout-readback-001.json).

**Next:** read back Scanpy controls, finish ownership-gated cleanup of retained images, and assess MMseqs2's bootstrap allowance if a separate model budget is recorded. Eleven terminal jobs used 2.94665 allocated CPU-hours; active Scanpy controls and OHIF cleanup reserve at most 9.83334 more under the 32-hour ceiling. Zero model calls or new capacity in this issue. The OHIF control archive and control-resource cleanup are verified; its reconstructed image cleanup is running. No pipeline promoted. Detailed logs remain in comments.

comment.body:
🤖 The four original OHIF exports (PRs 6334, 6339, 6346, 6352) each completed nop/oracle controls at the original 300-second verifier limit. Every pair was parseable and positive: nop reward 0, oracle reward 1, clean oracle command, and all tracked pass-to-pass tests pass on both sides. Fail-to-pass / pass-to-pass counts respectively were 6/1,411, 3/1,424, 5/1,435 and 2/1,441. All 40 task files match their original hashes before and after execution.

The job succeeded in 1,084.81 seconds using 1.20534 allocated CPU-hours. Its 853,986-byte archive was downloaded and verified (SHA256 `1a37563bf72b86870034ac8427e355808171a4a8e94576d094c78fdde7d61c36`); all control-owned resources were removed. This verifies four existing exports, without generation, task repair or model calls. The separately owned reconstruction image cleanup is submitted and still running. [Verified results](https://github.com/Open-Athena/biotasks/blob/a090c9ce/experiments/29-runtime-limits/ohif-control-results.json).
